    Lifting a null vector of a surjective specialization #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_polynomial_kernel_lift {k : Type u_1} {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} [CommRing k] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n (Polynomial k)) (C : Matrix n m k) (hC : A.map ⇑(Polynomial.evalRingHom 0) * C = 1) (v : n → k) (hv : (A.map ⇑(Polynomial.evalRingHom 0)).mulVec v = 0) :
    ∃ (w : n → Polynomial k), A.mulVec w = 0 ∧ ⇑(Polynomial.evalRingHom 0) ∘ w = v

    A null vector at a surjective specialization lifts to a polynomial null vector with the prescribed value at zero. The determinant and adjugate of the matrix obtained from a right inverse give a lift over the polynomial ring.
